notes.title: Patch 1 Released
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We have implemented a minor patch to fix some issues with the release build.

[list]
[*] Fixed broken thumbnails on the Forge world level select screen
[*] Fixed missing textures in some Forge levels
[*] Fixed rendering bug with mine explosions
[/list]
